workload.note: embedding model: prefill+norm+mean-pool only, no decode/LM-head/sampling

roofline_basis: 3.72 TFLOP matmul (all 5 roles BFP4/LoFi) / 580.9 TFLOPS measured P150 BFP4-LoFi peak (tech_reports/GEMM_FLOPS)
named_limitations: matmul at 42% of measured BFP4/LoFi peak (15.13 ms vs 6.40 ms roofline); legacy MatmulMultiCoreReuseMultiCast beats minimal_matmul at bs=1 (33.1 vs 49.0 ms) so MinimalMatmulConfig block/grid knobs are inert on this path
non-matmul ops are 45% of device time (12.5 ms) and were not reduced in this pass: SDPA 3.74, LayerNorm 3.70, BinaryNg 2.34, Rotary 1.66
LayerNorm cannot use the block-sharded path: dim=2560 exceeds the per-core LN budget, so QWEN_LN_BLOCK_SHARDED is inert on 4B
bs>=8 throughput is L1-capacity-bound: minimal_matmul blocks above (8,8,8) fail with statically-allocated dataflow buffers at 3.03 MB vs 1.57 MB L1, and the core grid is already maxed at 120
device is harvested 120/130 cores, so absolute numbers are ~8% pessimistic vs a full 13x10 P150
